description: Land Title Settlement Department - Doruwadeniya, Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Cad. Map No. 330301 (23/238)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and cadastral information. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
